name: Gorditas Durango
notes: OSM coords put this in Tecate, Baja California (not Campo, CA). No official website. Restaurant Guru hosts a user-uploaded photo of the full printed menu with MXN peso prices (10 menu versions). Verified visually via screenshot. IMAGE-ONLY menu.

name: Eureka!
notes: Chain. The marketing menu page (eurekarestaurantgroup.com/locations/san-diego-sdsu/menu) is accordion HTML with dish names and descriptions but NO prices. Their own ordering subdomain online.eurekarestaurantgroup.com (Toast-powered) has the full SDSU-location menu with prices as plain text. 45 food items + 13 drinks.

name: Grater Greens
notes: Official Wix site (gratergreens.com/menus?menu=dinner-menu) lists 12 salads/bowls with ingredient descriptions but NO prices. DoorDash brand menu page has 38 priced items across 8 categories. Note: Yelp marks the Mission Center Rd location Temp. CLOSED; the Scranton Rd/Sorrento location is still listed.

name: Rolberto's  Taco Shop
notes: No official website at all. Yelp's menu tab has the complete priced menu as plain HTML: 4 breakfast burritos, 22 burritos, 13 tacos, 14 sides, 20 combination plates, 5 extras, 16 drinks. Uber Eats (rolbertos-taco-shop-adams-ave) also carries a full priced menu.

name: Kaiyo Sushi
notes: No official website found. Yelp menu tab has the full priced menu as plain HTML (~87 items across 15 sections: rice plates, Korean noodle soups, classic/special/favorite rolls, chef's specials, salads, bento, drinks). Postmates/Uber Eats also list it priced. Actual address is 2110 Birch Rd, Chula Vista, not Otay Mesa.

name: Golden Hill Cafe
notes: Only 'official' site is goldenhillcafesd.webzum.com, an auto-generated SEO marketing page with NO menu at all. Yelp has no menu tab (redirects to biz page). Zmenu hosts 2 PHOTOS of the physical menu with legible prices (Hotcakes Combo $7.50, omelettes $11.50) - image only, no structured text. Item count is an estimate from the photos. No delivery listing found.

name: Country Waffles
notes: OSM node 3788869870 (last edited 2015) reverse-geocodes to 2323 Midway Drive. That Country Waffles closed and relocated to 9350 Clairemont Mesa Blvd (Kearny Mesa) in Jan 2023; the Midway building is now The Britannia Tearooms. The mapped restaurant no longer exists at this location. The relocated Kearny Mesa store is still operating and does have priced listings elsewhere, but that is a different address.

name: Avian Sandwiches Fresh Drinking Water & Boba
notes: No official website - it is a banh mi/boba counter inside a water store (Yelp lists it under 'Avian Fresh Drinking Water', Water Purification Services). DoorDash and its white-label order.online mirror both show priced items (Banh Mi $11.65, Spring Rolls $15.50, Vietnamese Iced Coffee $7.80) across 7 categories: Tea, Latte, Juice, Smoothies, Dessert, Food, Special Rolls. Full item list is lazy-loaded and would not render without an address, so item_count is an ESTIMATE. Uber Eats/Postmates hit a bot challenge; an older Uber Eats account for this address is marked closed as of Dec 2025.

name: Happy Time Mediterranean Restaurant
notes: Cleanest case in the batch. Official Wix site has a single /menu page in plain HTML with names, descriptions and prices for all 67 items across 11 sections (cold/hot apps, entrees, saj wraps, loaded fries, burgers, bowls, to-go, family feasts, desserts, sides). Actual address is 2441 Jamacha Rd, El Cajon, not Jamul.

name: Casa Angelo Pizza
notes: OSM node 4041798689 reverse-geocodes to 823 W San Marcos Blvd, San Marcos (not Rancho Santa Fe). Yelp biz page shows the red banner 'Yelpers report this location has closed' - verified visually. No website, no delivery listing, no relocated location found.
